title: Yochanan ben Beteira, a Tanna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman cites Zevachim 23a for him, but reports that Dikdukei Soferim and Shitah Mekubetzet read Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira, as in Menachot 8b. Menachot 41b says that the elders of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel went up to Yochanan ben Beteira’s upper room; Hyman reports Yonatan in Shitah Mekubetzet and Sifrei Shelach.

notes.text: Yehudah, Yochanan and Yonatan ben Beteira are the readings attributed to the cited witnesses. The upper room is connected with the named host, not with a new reporting authority.

The consulted Menachot 41b reads Yochanan ben Beteira; the bounded opening of Sifrei Bamidbar 115 reads Yonatan ben Beteira. The exact Dikdukei Soferim and Shitah Mekubetzet readings were not independently inspected and remain Hyman’s report.
